compiled_state.title: T1: Stage reference bug set and run ci-pr mode validation session
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context
Story: 562a-0cf1-cf51-4673 — reference /debug-everything session validates ci-pr mode delivers ≥3 sub-branches, ≥95% pass-rate, ≤5% token variance vs direct mode

## Goal
Execute the acceptance validation for this epic: run /debug-everything in ci-pr mode against ≥8 bug tickets, then in direct mode for baseline, and record all metrics as ticket comments.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE (integration validation — no unit test file needed)

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| n/a (runtime validation) | n/a | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Stage reference bug set: find existing open P2-P4 bug tickets or create ≥8 synthetic minimal bugs with known trivial fixes (e.g., add missing newline, fix single-line type annotation)
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --status=open 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | .ticket_id' | head -10
   If <8 real bugs, create synthetic ones.

2. Record bug IDs as REFERENCE_BUG_SET: comment on this ticket

3. Run /debug-everything in ci-pr mode on a clean branch:
   - Ensure merge.strategy=pr in .claude/dso-config.conf (or set temporarily)
   - Record: session start time, sub-branch count, per-sub-branch review verdicts, total token spend from session logs

4. On a clean branch, run the IDENTICAL bug-ID list in direct mode:
   - Change merge.strategy=direct temporarily
   - Record: token spend

5. Assert acceptance criteria:
   - ci-pr sub-branch count ≥3 ✓/✗
   - sub-branch pass-rate ≥95% (without escalation) ✓/✗
   - ci-pr token spend ≤ direct mode token spend + 5% ✓/✗

6. Record all results as ticket comment on this story:
   REFERENCE_RUN_RESULTS: ci-pr-subbranches=<N> pass-rate=<N>% cipr-tokens=<N> direct-tokens=<N> variance=<N>% VERDICT=PASS|FAIL

## Acceptance Criteria
- REFERENCE_BUG_SET comment on this story listing ≥8 bug ticket IDs
- REFERENCE_RUN_RESULTS comment with all metrics recorded
- ci-pr sub-branch count ≥3
- Sub-branch pass-rate ≥95%
- Token variance ≤5%
- If any criterion fails: add VALIDATION_FAIL: comment and keep story open for investigation
